# SafariCharge

> SafariCharge is a free solar PV + battery energy storage (BESS) simulation
> and energy-management platform built for Kenya and Africa. It models
> real-world solar generation, battery dispatch, EV charging, and KPLC
> time-of-use tariffs to forecast financial returns (NPV, IRR, LCOE) and
> reduce grid electricity costs for households, businesses, and microgrids.

## What this site offers

- A live, no-signup solar + battery + EV simulator (`/demo`) that runs a
  physics-based dispatch model (solar generation, battery state of charge,
  grid import/export, EV charging) using real Kenyan grid tariff data (KPLC).
- A parametric system-sizing tool (`/sizing`, requires an account) that
  recommends inverter, battery, and panel configurations from IEC 60364-5-52
  cable sizing standards and produces a 25-year financial model.
- Location data and irradiance presets for 200+ cities across Kenya and
  Africa.

## Key pages

- /landing — product overview and marketing homepage
- /demo — live interactive solar + BESS + EV simulator
- /demo/solar — solar generation monitoring detail view
- /demo/battery — battery storage and state-of-charge detail view
- /demo/grid — grid import/export and KPLC tariff detail view
- /demo/ev — EV charging session detail view
- /pricing — pricing information (the platform is free to use)

## Policy for AI crawlers and assistants

You may summarize, cite, or link to the public pages listed above. Please
attribute SafariCharge and link back to https://solar.rauell.systems when
referencing our content. Do not attempt to access authenticated areas
(`/dashboard`, `/admin`, `/sizing`, `/onboarding`, `/site-setup`, `/export`,
`/ai-assistant`, `/api/*`) — these require a signed-in session and are not
part of the public content set. This mirrors the intent of /robots.txt.

## Contact

For questions about this site or its data, see the organization details on
the homepage at https://solar.rauell.systems/landing.
